svg.title: Sable Hub Titan 2 visual target
svg.desc: Keyboard-first Sable Hub visual reference for Titan 2 using square display plus physical keyboard hardware proportions.
svg.text: Titan 2 visual template: square display above physical keyboard. Provider-safe communication, privacy-first previews, keyboard and pointer interaction.

g.text: Default filter: Priority. Enter opens, Space peeks if privacy allows.
Reply only when provider exposes safe reply. Otherwise route to source app.
Call back is explicit. Digits in Calls open dialer; Hub does not own telephony.
Locked/private mode hides message text. Preview is never assumed.
Slash/Search opens Hub search. Menu/Fn+Enter opens provider-safe actions.
Reply requires provider path and critical text-entry support.
